definitions.explanation: A person who gathers, organizes, and edits material into a systematic reference work such as a dictionary, encyclopedia, anthology, or historical chronicle.

examples.japanese: {辞書|じしょ}の{編纂者|へんさんしゃ}は{何年|なんねん}もかけてこの{仕事|しごと}を{完成|かんせい}させた。
examples.english: The dictionary's compiler spent many years completing this work.

examples.japanese: {百科事典|ひゃっかじてん}の{編纂者|へんさんしゃ}チームが{新版|しんぱん}の{準備|じゅんび}を{進|すす}めている。
examples.english: The encyclopedia's editorial team is preparing a new edition.

examples.japanese: {編纂者|へんさんしゃ}として{名高|なだか}い{金田一|きんだいち}{京助|きょうすけ}は、{日本語|にほんご}{辞書|じしょ}の{発展|はってん}に{大|おお}きく{貢献|こうけん}した。
examples.english: Kindaichi Kyosuke, renowned as a compiler, made great contributions to the development of Japanese dictionaries.

notes:
A compound of {編纂|へんさん} (compilation, editing) and {者|しゃ} (person). Specifically refers to someone who compiles large-scale reference works, as opposed to a general editor who edits individual works.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {辞書|じしょ}の{編纂者|へんさんしゃ}: dictionary compiler
- {百科事典|ひゃっかじてん}の{編纂者|へんさんしゃ}: encyclopedia editor
- {歴史書|れきししょ}の{編纂者|へんさんしゃ}: compiler of historical records
- {主|しゅ}{編纂者|へんさんしゃ}: chief editor/compiler

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {編集者|へんしゅうしゃ}: editor — a more general term for someone who edits books, magazines, or other publications
- {著者|ちょしゃ}: author — someone who writes original content, rather than compiling existing material
- {監修者|かんしゅうしゃ}: supervisor, general editor — someone who oversees a project without doing the hands-on compilation
